newsitem.title: USA: Global High Income Dollar Q4 shr off.
newsitem.headline: Global High Income Dollar Q4 shr off.

text.p: Global High Income Dollar Fund Inc said on Tuesday, after the market closed, that net investment income for the fourth quarter ended October 31, 1996, was $7,046,346, or $0.31 a share, compared to $7,815,337, or $0.34 a share the previous fourth quarter.
For the fourth quarter, net realized and unrealized gains were $14,430,486, or $0.63 a share for the same period, compared to gains of $3,760,695, or $0.17 a share the year before.

For the twelve months ended October 31, 1996, the Fund's earnings from net investment income were $29,631,958, or $1.30 a share, with net realized and unrealized gains of $43,111,774, or $1.89 a share.
This compares to net investment income of $30,471,283, or $1.34 a share, and net realized and unrealized gains of $4,603,769, or $0.20 a share, the previous fiscal year.
On October 31, 1996, total net assets of the Fund were $340,909,979 and net asset value per common share was $14.99.
Net asset value per share was $13.07 a year earlier.
